problem.title: The problem we solve
problem.description: Pet owners struggle to maintain consistent care routines. Missing medication doses, forgetting feeding times, or losing track of care history can have serious consequences.
problem.point1: Forgetting critical care tasks like medication or feeding schedules
problem.point2: Lack of organization when managing multiple pets with different needs
problem.point3: No historical record to track what care was provided and when
problem.point4: Existing solutions are too complex, expensive, or lack essential features

audience.title: Who it's for
audience.description: LaNature is designed for pet owners who want clarity, organization, and peace of mind.

ideal.title: Ideal users
ideal.description: Pet owners who need a simple, reliable system to track daily care routines without complexity.

multiPet.title: Multi-pet households
multiPet.description: Owners managing multiple pets with different schedules and care requirements.

scope.title: What LaNature doesn't do
scope.description: We focus on care routine management. Here's what's intentionally out of scope:
scope.not1: Veterinary medical records or diagnosis (we track care, not medical conditions)
scope.not2: Social features or community (we're focused on individual pet care)
scope.not3: E-commerce or product sales (we're a management tool, not a marketplace)
scope.not4: Advanced analytics or AI predictions (we keep it simple and reliable)

completed.title: Completed
completed.description: Core features: pet management, routine scheduling, task completion tracking, and care history.

next.description: Mobile app, reminders/notifications, and export functionality for care records.

future.title: Future considerations
future.description: Potential features: medication inventory tracking, vet appointment scheduling, and care templates.
